title: “Export your vault for recovery”
scenario: A message claiming to be from your password-manager provider says a synchronization error could corrupt your vault and asks you to export it to a recovery portal immediately.

answers.A: Back up using the product’s documented local recovery method only after verifying the issue independently.
answers.B: Export the vault but encrypt the file before uploading it to the recovery portal.
answers.C: Do not export the vault; open the password manager directly and contact support through its official site/app.

explanation: A password vault export is a concentrated copy of your credentials. Encryption does not help if the attacker controls the recovery process or key entry.
proTip: Your vault is the crown jewels; recovery should never begin from an unsolicited link.
